facts.fact: 晚饭后，维罗妮卡和尼克坐在尼克公寓的沙发上，两人都没吃多少东西。
facts.anchor: The two of them were sitting on the sofa in his apartment after dinner.

facts.fact: 维罗妮卡曾在总部与前进作战基地爆炸中遇害的一名女同事共事。
facts.anchor: Veronica had worked at Headquarters with one of the women killed at Forward Operating Base ██████ .

facts.fact: 埃迪每天清晨六点十五分到办公室，因此总能把银色双排轮皮卡停在同一个车位。
facts.anchor: he got in at six fifteen every morning

facts.fact: 两周后的一场暴雨中，埃迪才发现卡在雨刷下的死青蛙。
facts.anchor: It was two weeks before he noticed, during a rainstorm

facts.fact: 最精彩的一次，马拉找两个帮手把埃迪的割草机从皮卡后斗搬进驾驶室。
facts.anchor: was the time Marla got two guys to help her move Eddie’s lawnmower from the dualie’s truck bed into the cab

facts.fact: 九月时马拉告诉维罗妮卡，她和埃迪已秘密交往六个月。
facts.anchor: She told me back in September that they had been going out on the sly for six months

facts.fact: 今天早上埃迪把买给马拉的戒指拿给维罗妮卡看。
facts.anchor: This morning Eddie showed me the ring he had bought her
